measured_native_timing.note: garden/bicycle P16_RUN.json present in same dir; room used as representative. training_wall_s = training callbacks only (final render/checkpoint excluded).

state_recovery_fraction_of_backward.estimate: state-recovery (replay recurrence + checkpoint) is a small fraction of total backward; backward also does gradient math (dL_dcolor/dalpha/conic/mean2d), preprocess (cov3d, SH, jacobian), and Adam. State-recovery recurrence ~10-17 flop/visit vs gradient math ~30-40 flop/visit.
state_recovery_fraction_of_backward.implication: even a 20% reduction in state-recovery work is <~10% of total backward; backward is ~1/3 of training step (forward+backward+optim)

e2e_model.assumptions: f_bwd=0.33 (backward share of step), frac_state=0.25 (state-recovery share of backward), red_state=0.20 (Gate4 borderline reduction)
e2e_model.note: even IF Gate 4 passed at 20%, the E2E ceiling from state-recovery alone is ~1.02x — below the 1.05x Gate 6 threshold. Gate 6 requires the recoverable work to map to >=1.05x E2E in >=2/3 scenes; state-recovery alone cannot reach it.

verdict_rationale: Gate 6 requires conservative optimistic E2E >=1.05x in >=2/3 scenes. State-recovery is a small fraction of the backward, which is itself a fraction of the training step. Even granting the full (borderline) Gate 4 reduction, the E2E ceiling from state-recovery alone is ~1.02x, below 1.05x. Gate 6 fails independently of Gate 4.
